notesI18n.zh: 修复自定义/中转服务商下“每次发送都弹费用确认”的误报：不再拿配置的 endpoint 别名与 CLI 上报的上游模型名比较来判断模型切换；价目未知时不再拦截发送。
notesI18n.en: Fix false “confirm context cost” prompts on custom/relay providers: model changes are now detected from the configured model across turns instead of comparing the endpoint alias with the upstream model name reported by the CLI; sends are no longer blocked when pricing is unknown.
